summary: Nora picks up the words this room has made its own, and knows what they mean here.
details: A word your group uses in its own way — one that means nothing to an outsider and may not have existed a month ago — used to be invisible to her unless somebody had just said it in the last few messages.
She now builds up a small glossary from what people actually say in the room, with a real quote under each entry so you can see where it came from, and keeps it current as words arrive and fade.
It is a glossary, not a vocabulary list: it tells her what your words mean, and is not a set of words for her to start using.
She never learns from her own messages, and nothing in it describes a person.
limitations: Ships turned off. It is not live in any room yet.
